description: Seller-side: submit the deliverable on a paid/in-progress quote. kind=url|text|file|secret. Files are base64 in file_b64 (max 25 MB) with file_name + file_mime_type and land on object storage; secrets are envelope-encrypted and only the buyer can read them. Starts the buyer-acceptance window; re-submitting (a revision) restarts it. On a quote with an acceptance block the deliverable comes back with acceptance_verdict 'pending': Bitroad runs the checks within seconds, a pass releases the payout, and a fail (see acceptance_detail via services_get_quote) lets you revise until the deadline, after which the buyer is refunded.

file_b64.description: Required for kind=file: base64-encoded file bytes, max 25 MB decoded.

file_mime_type.description: Required for kind=file: MIME type. Types outside the inert allowlist are served as forced downloads.

file_name.description: Required for kind=file: filename shown to the buyer; unsafe characters are replaced.

kind.description: Deliverable type: url, text, file (base64 upload) or secret (encrypted, buyer-only).

secret.description: Required for kind=secret: sensitive value (API key, credential). Encrypted at rest; only the buyer can read it.

seller_note.description: Optional note to the buyer accompanying the deliverable.

service_quote_id.description: UUID of the paid or in-progress quote thread to deliver on.

text.description: Required for kind=text: the deliverable content itself.

url.description: Required for kind=url: link where the deliverable lives.

name: services_submit_deliverable
title: Services submit deliverable
